name: Product carousel
description: Swipe through the first eight products.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/product-carousel", name: "Product carousel", kind: Kind.productCollection,
  description: "Swipe through the first eight products.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Carousel(itemWidth: 180, gap: Space.md, showArrows: true, children: [ForEach(items: options.products, as: "p", limit: 8, child: Box(radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), clip: true, child: Column(children: [
        Image(src: p.image_url, alt: p.name, aspectRatio: 1.33, fit: Fit.cover),
        Column(padding: Space.sm, gap: Space.xs, children: [
          Text(child: p.name, weight: FontWeight.semibold, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
          Text(child: formatMoney(p.display_price_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold),
          Button(label: "View", size: Size.sm, style: ButtonStyle.secondary, fullWidth: true, onTap: OpenProduct(product: p))
        ])
      ])))])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "products", type: Product, list: true, required: true)],
)
